entities.summary: Steven Springer (b. 1951-09-23, Port of Spain) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Port of Spain and United States. Known in the fields of united states, composers & musicians, americas.
